related_resources.reason: Peer-reviewed article abstract and institutional metadata document east African shared pottery and varying regional forms. Ceramic similarity alone cannot establish shared ethnicity.
Open historical archaeology commentary on Phillipson 1979 survey at lower Tana and changing archaeological narratives. Does not imply all finds have same origins.
Open data paper records 2000-plus sherds, forty variables, eight selected coastal and hinterland sites, and comparative sampling limits.
Publisher abstract on Kimimba and Tumbe, Kaliwa and Chwaka. Rural comparisons are not coast-wide statistics.

Full open article covering Shungwaya debates, Helm settlement surveys, and named Mijikenda elder Thomas Govi. Later narratives and interpretive frameworks are not firsthand testimony from the eighth century.
Publisher abstract supports intensive exchange and possible shell-bead production in household settings without pronounced excavated stratification. Not proof of equality.
